dict.string: Zuffi reads the title of the active window so you can ask about it.
Zuffi controls apps you ask it to, like Spotify, Music, Mail and your terminal.
Zuffi uses your location to tell you the weather where you are.
Zuffi uses your location to tell you the weather where you are.
Zuffi saves and finds phone numbers when you ask, like "save this number as Ali".
Zuffi looks through the camera only when you ask, like "Zuffi, what do you see?" or "take a photo".
Zuffi listens when you hold the voice shortcut so you can talk to it.
Zuffi turns your voice into text on your Mac.
Zuffi shows your next meetings in Today at a glance.
Zuffi shows and adds your to-dos.
Zuffi shows the battery of your AirPods and other Bluetooth devices.
